Reading the two views

Each point in configuration space represents one arm pose. θ₁ rotates the first link from the horizontal; θ₂ rotates the second link relative to the first. Opposite edges of the map connect, because angles repeat every full turn.

The map samples possible poses, so its boundary is approximate. The collision indicator always checks the current pose directly. Obstacles can overlap, and colliding poses remain selectable.

Adapted from Robot Motion with Obstacles by Aaron T. Becker, Wolfram Demonstrations Project.
